value.evidence:
Independent re-check by the QA agent for hunter expire76.

VERDICT pass -- the check that recorded this defect now passes, under the definition PINNED for this row. That pin was written by us rather than taken from the failing run, so this is not automatically the identical test; our reason is below, judge it.

WHAT THE FINGERPRINT IS: a SHA-256 of the check function's parsed syntax tree. It changes when the check's logic changes and not when its comments or formatting do. It is the pinned definition, which is not necessarily the one recorded at the failure. Why this row carries a pin, in our own words: Report #73 documents the original failure: stats and the leaderboard disagreeing on what hunters had earned. Deep pass 2026-09-08, 3/3: the pass sentence asserted both reconciliations unconditionally when either can be skipped unmeasured -- 'matches the None it is defined as' with no published definition, and the leaderboard's own figure printed on both sides of a comparison that never ran. The sentence now says which half was measured and which was not.

RUN: run-20260908T150954Z-95f0a70, preregistration PRE-0073, on a clean working tree at commit 95f0a703e969d26a00e6d1924e99cd042e4ba55e. The selector was frozen and git-tagged BEFORE the run, so the set of checks could not be narrowed after seeing the results.

CHECK(S) THIS COVERS:
  tests/rest/test_reward_totals_agree.py::test_the_reward_totals_agree_with_each_other

REPRODUCE: github.com/zakutana/qa-cymetica at 95f0a703e969d26a00e6d1924e99cd042e4ba55e, then
  pytest tests/rest/test_reward_totals_agree.py::test_the_reward_totals_agree_with_each_other

FINDING CYM-reward-totals-disagree: stats records 36000.0 awarded and 2000.0 paid, and every one of the 2 hunter(s) on the leaderboard shows total_earned 0.0; the leaderboard lists all 2 hunter(s) and accounts for 21 valid report(s), while stats calls 40 valid
